name.zh-CN: 调阅第二次住院肺活检

zh-CN: 调阅第二次住院肺活检

text.zh-CN: 右下叶结节中央急性炎性坏死及少许纤维素样物质，周围类上皮细胞栅栏排列，间质淋巴细胞浸润。
text.en: A right lower-lobe nodule showed central inflammatory necrosis with fibrinoid material, palisading epithelioid cells and interstitial lymphocytes.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 首次抗感染后短暂改善，一周后加重；肺活检后加用激素，影像改善。数年后不规律用免疫治疗又复发，抗感染12天效果不佳；调整抗生素并加激素后血痰消失、空洞壁变薄，口服泼尼松出院。长期后续未载。
text.en: Antibiotics initially gave temporary improvement, followed by relapse a week later. Steroids after biopsy accompanied imaging improvement. Years later, irregular immunotherapy preceded recurrence; 12 days of antibiotics failed to improve imaging. Changing antibiotics and adding steroids was followed by resolution of bloody sputum and thinner cavity walls; she left on prednisone. Later long-term follow-up is absent.

text.zh-CN: 类风湿肺结节最受支持，同时继续排查合并感染
text.en: Rheumatoid pulmonary nodules are best supported, while assessing coexisting infection

feedback.zh-CN: 坏死周围栅栏结构与高RF和长期关节病相吻合。
feedback.en: Palisading around necrosis fits the high RF and longstanding arthritis.

text.zh-CN: 一次阴性ANCA足以排除所有血管炎
text.en: A negative ANCA excludes every vasculitis

feedback.zh-CN: 阴性抗体没有这样的排除力。
feedback.en: A negative antibody test is not universally exclusionary.

text.zh-CN: 空洞必定为活动性肺结核
text.en: Cavities necessarily mean active tuberculosis

feedback.zh-CN: 空洞有多种病因，组织结果更支持类风湿结节。
feedback.en: Cavities have several causes; the tissue favours rheumatoid nodules.

text.zh-CN: 呼吸与风湿团队联合评估感染及药物相关结节，再个体化抗炎治疗
text.en: Respiratory and rheumatology teams assess infection and medication-associated nodules before individualising anti-inflammatory care

feedback.zh-CN: 免疫抑制风险要求先核对感染证据，不能仅凭RF决定。
feedback.en: Immunosuppression risk requires infection review, not a decision from RF alone.

text.en: Escalate antibiotics indefinitely while ignoring histology

text.en: Use long-term steroids independently because RF is high

feedback.zh-CN: 需要评估感染、病情和监测计划。

feedback.zh-CN: 原报告同时调整抗生素和激素，不能分离各自效果。

text.zh-CN: 激素后改善证明任何感染均已排除

feedback.zh-CN: 治疗反应不能取代病原学评估。

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 肺活检结合关节病史支持类风湿肺结节；反复空洞仍须重估感染等病因。
conclusion.en: Biopsy and arthritis history support rheumatoid pulmonary nodules; recurrent cavities still require reassessment for infection and other causes.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 不要用RF或空洞单独定病因。
keyReasoning.en: Do not determine aetiology from RF or cavities alone.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 类风湿患者仍可合并感染和恶性肿瘤。
keyReasoning.en: Rheumatoid disease does not preclude infection or malignancy.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 原病例联合治疗不能证明某单药的效果。
keyReasoning.en: Combined treatment in this report cannot establish one drug’s efficacy.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.
